verdict.rationale: The New York Department of State runs online filing and entity-search services, so an official CLI is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no CLI at all: filing is through a web Online-Filing System or by mail. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, no llms.txt and no markdown docs, and the filing host reset the probe's connection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
